Vendored byte for byte from flux/bundle-deploy/src/. Never edit these here.
Fix them at the source and copy them over.

app-release-core.js holds the app release rules: what a signed release holds, and which releases count.
The FXN Browser updater uses the same rules.

folder-site-core.js was added 2026-10-29. It holds the two site formats, the reader for the
index format, and the one list of headers a site may set in its _headers file.
The pack command refuses a _headers rule outside that list.
The .fxn site server reads the list from this copy, so both judge a site by one list.
It imports app-release-core.js for the block size, so the two files travel together.

Resync command, from the defxn repo root:
  cp ../bundle-deploy/src/{app-release-core,folder-site-core}.js gateway/vendor/bundle-deploy/
